dfm_alerts.description: The rechargeable pack is specified without cell retention, wire routing, thermal separation or vent provisions. A factory cannot validate safe assembly near the motor.
dfm_alerts.fix: Define pack mounting, harness restraints, clearances and a vent path; verify thermal and abuse behavior in the assembled product.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Safety requirements for household electrical appliances and vacuum cleaners — IEC 60335-1 and IEC 60335-2-2

dfm_alerts.description: The boss pilot is specified, but boss outside diameter, engagement depth and screw-hole condition are not. The selected self-tapping screws may split bosses or strip during assembly.
dfm_alerts.fix: Define boss geometry and pilot depth against the screw supplier's PC/ABS recommendations; validate insertion and strip torque on molded samples.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Size molded screw bosses for the selected fastener and resin — Protolabs injection molding design guide

dfm_alerts.description: Shell mating-face and split-line requirements lack datums and an assembled inspection method; independent part tolerances do not guarantee the required assembled step.
dfm_alerts.fix: Add a datum scheme, locating features and a tolerance stack-up; specify how the step is measured on assembled shells.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Geometric tolerances require defined datum references for functional inspection — ISO 1101

dfm_alerts.description: The charging interface and protected pack have no defined electrical compatibility or charge-control requirements, leaving the factory without a testable charging specification.
dfm_alerts.fix: Specify charger output, pack charge limits, protection functions, connector polarity and end-of-line charging tests.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Safety requirements and tests for portable sealed secondary lithium cells and batteries — IEC 62133-2

dfm_alerts.description: The flame-rated PC/ABS callout does not identify an approved resin grade or confirm that the specified color retains the required rating.
dfm_alerts.fix: Specify a supplier grade and obtain flame-rating documentation for the production formulation and applicable thickness.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Flammability classification applies to tested plastic material specimens — UL 94

dfm_alerts.description: Projected area along +Z: 24904 mm² (part silhouette, per cavity). Estimated clamp force ≈ 127.4 t (Estimate: area in² × 3.0 t/in² for PC/ABS × 1.1 safety) — per cavity; a family tool moulding both shells in one shot roughly doubles it.
dfm_alerts.fix: Quote on a press ≥ 160 t; keep both shells in one family mould only if tonnage allows.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Clamp force ≈ projected area × cavity-pressure factor (2-5 t/in²) — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; silhouette raster from text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

measurement.label: measured

dfm_alerts.description: Measured wall 2.20-2.20 mm is within the PC/ABS 1.2-3.5 mm range; keep bosses/ribs ≤ 60% of nominal wall to avoid sink.
dfm_alerts.fix: No change to nominal wall; core bosses and ribs to ≤ 60% of the wall.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: PC/ABS wall 1.2-3.5 mm, ribs/bosses ≤ 60% of wall — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines

questions.en: DFM critical — The rechargeable pack is specified without cell retention, wire routing, thermal separation or vent provisions. A factory cannot validate safe assembly near the motor. Proposed fix: Define pack mounting, harness restraints, clearances and a vent path; verify thermal and abuse behavior in the assembled product. Can you accommodate this, and at what cost or lead-time impact?
questions.cn: DFM 关键问题 — 可充电电池组的规格中未定义电芯固定、走线布置、隔热分离或泄压通道。工厂无法验证其在电机附近装配的安全性。建议解决方案：定义电池组安装方式、线束固定、间隙及泄压路径；在整机装配状态下验证热性能及滥用测试表现。贵厂能否满足此要求？对成本或交期有何影响？
questions.cn_review_note: Machine-translated — to be reviewed by a native speaker

questions.en: DFM major — The boss pilot is specified, but boss outside diameter, engagement depth and screw-hole condition are not. The selected self-tapping screws may split bosses or strip during assembly. Proposed fix: Define boss geometry and pilot depth against the screw supplier's PC/ABS recommendations; validate insertion and strip torque on molded samples. Can you accommodate this, and at what cost or lead-time impact?
questions.cn: DFM 主要问题 — 已指定凸台导引孔，但未指定凸台外径、啮合深度及螺孔状态。所选自攻螺丝可能在装配时导致凸台开裂或滑牙。建议解决方案：根据螺丝供应商的 PC/ABS 建议定义凸台几何形状和导引孔深度；在注塑样品上验证旋入扭矩和滑牙扭矩。贵厂能否满足此要求？对成本或交期有何影响？

build_strategy.title: Module assembly
build_strategy.explanation: You design the product around bought-in, pre-certified modules (e.g. motor + driver, battery pack, radio module, heater + fan): your work is the architecture, the enclosure, the integration and the software; the factory assembles the modules into your parts. Faster and cheaper than designing every sub-system, and the modules' certifications carry part of the compliance.
